rules.topic: Fuel loader (config defaults): fluid buffer 8000, transfer rate 250, working range 2 blocks; it auto-fuels rockets near it, removing the manual bucket step before launch
Automation NASA workbench (config defaults): energy capacity 9600, energy usage 24, craft time 200 ticks per rocket recipe; it is the automatable variant of the NASA workbench

Gravity normalizer (config defaults): energy capacity 9600; running cost 0.5 energy per block of the normalized volume (x * y * z); maximum area length 31 blocks; it forces Earth-like gravity inside the area while powered
Rocket sensor (config default): detects rockets within 2 blocks in each direction and emits a redstone signal, for launch automation with the fuel loader
